name: safari
title: Safari
description: A Safari browser mockup to showcase your website.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the mockup (it fills the width of its parent by default).

props.name: url
props.description: Text shown in the address bar.

props.name: videoSrc
props.description: Video shown in the window (autoplays muted and loops). Takes precedence over imageSrc.

props.name: width
props.description: Width in pixels. The height follows the aspect ratio.

props.name: height
props.description: Height in pixels. Set it instead of width to size the mockup by height.
